Substantive sources per route: 9 named-roster, 4 bibliography-chasing (Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing, Rettberg, arXiv 2604.20048, Gao and Thebault-Spieker), 4 lateral (Intrepid Times, BBC Travel, OHS, Governing) — 17 substantive sources and 79 claims, plus 3 non-substantive entries (2 relays used only for routing, 1 negative result). Two sources blocked and routed around: dl.acm.org (abstract taken from the authors' institution page, marked abstract-only) and nytimes.com (Wayback). Two consecutive lateral searches surfaced only sources already read or off-angle, so the roster is treated as exhausted. The gap the method calls worth most is partly filled: four sources measure or catalogue the ENCYCLOPEDIC or GAZETTEER register directly, and five carry MECHANISM rather than tell.
